Some people do great after a lesson, some take time.  I practice in the 100's normally, took a few lessons, and posted scores in the low 90s ( or close to that). Thought I figured it out.  A few rounds later, I shot a 125, my worst round ever. If you're learning something completely new, it's really hard to stick with swinging in a way that feels very uncomfortable for you, and is much easier to go to your old habits, because it feels comfortable and familiar. Keep at it, practice what he teaches until it gets a little more comfortable, and if he's a halfway decent teacher you should notice soon.  But you can't learn what he teaches, not go and practice, and expect to play lights out right away.  Some people do, sure, but not everyone. Keep it up, don't count yourself out, practice your ass off, and I'll be the first to upvote your post of your scorecard when you shoot the best round of your life! Cheers
